metadata.author: Research Team
metadata.description: Proteus coding task surveys with AI intent display study

pre_survey.title: Pre-Study Survey
pre_survey.description: Please answer the following questions before starting the coding task. All questions are required.

questions.question: What is your current education level?
How much experience do you have in programming?
questions.help_text: 1 = No experience, 2 = Beginner (< 6 months), 3 = Intermediate (6–24 months), 4 = Advanced (2–4 years), 5 = Expert (4+ years or professional)

questions.question: How frequently do you use AI coding assistants like GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or other coding agents?
questions.help_text: 1 = Never, 2 = Rarely (once a month or less), 3 = Occasionally (a few times a month), 4 = Frequently (a few times a week), 5 = Very frequently (daily or almost daily)

questions.content: Please answer the following questions with respect to your usage of AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot (similar to ChatGPT). Choose N/A if you have no experience with the tool.

image.alt: GitHub Copilot AI coding assistant demonstration

questions.question: I can trust the system.
questions.help_text: Choose N/A if you have no experience with the tool

questions.question: I am suspicious of the system's intent, action, or outputs.
questions.help_text: Choose N/A if you have no experience with the tool

questions.question: I am confident in the system.
questions.help_text: Choose N/A if you have no experience with the tool

questions.question: The system is reliable.
questions.help_text: Choose N/A if you have no experience with the tool

questions.question: Please describe why you trust or distrust AI for use in coding in your own words.
questions.placeholder: Describe the factors that influence your trust or distrust in AI coding assistants...

questions.question: Please describe in your own words, how you think AI Coding Assistants generate code suggestions?
questions.placeholder: Explain your understanding of how AI generates code suggestions...

questions.question: How accurate do you believe AI-generated code suggestions are?
questions.help_text: Move the slider to indicate your perceived accuracy (0% = completely inaccurate, 100% = perfectly accurate)

post_survey.title: Post-Study Survey
post_survey.description: Thank you for completing the task! Please share your experience with the AI coding assistant. All questions are required.

questions.question: How frequently did you change your code to align the AI's intention with yours?
Why did you trust or distrust the AI's suggestion or guess? Please describe.
questions.placeholder: Describe factors that increased or reduced your trust (e.g., correctness, clarity, past performance, uncertainty cues).

questions.question: Describe how your trust in the AI's suggestion or guess changed when its suggestion conflicted with your intended approach.
questions.placeholder: Explain whether your trust increased, decreased, or stayed the same—and why.

questions.question: Describe the strategies you used while coding to help the AI produce better suggestions or guesses.
questions.placeholder: E.g., clarifying prompts, restructuring code, adding comments/tests, smaller steps, specifying libraries.

questions.question: Which version of the tool did you prefer?
questions.help_text: Please refer to the comparison image below showing both conditions

image.alt: Side-by-side comparison of Condition 1 and Condition 2 interfaces
image.caption: Figure 1: Comparison of the two conditions

questions.question: Can you explain why you chose this version and how it helped you complete the programming assignment?
questions.placeholder: Explain your preference and how it supported your work.

questions.question: Condition 1: Share your overall experience when only suggestions were visible—what helped and what hindered in solving the programming assignment?
questions.help_text: Please refer to Condition 1 shown in the image below

image.alt: Screenshot of Condition 1 interface showing only suggestions
image.caption: Condition 1: Suggestions only interface

questions.question: Condition 2: Share your overall experience when the AI's intent was visible—what helped and what hindered in solving the programming assignment?
questions.help_text: Please refer to Condition 2 shown in the image below

image.alt: Screenshot of Condition 2 interface showing AI intent and suggestions
image.caption: Condition 2: AI intent + suggestions interface

questions.question: Displaying the AI coding assistant's guess helped me complete the programming problem.
Displaying the AI coding assistant's guess was _____ in completing the problem.
questions.help_text: 1 = Very unhelpful, 2 = Unhelpful, 3 = No impact, 4 = Helpful, 5 = Very helpful

questions.question: Seeing the AI's intent in real time made me realize that the AI's guess might be different from mine.
How would you prefer to interact with an AI coding assistant (for example, by typing text, highlighting code, or selecting options) so that it best understands your problem, and why?
questions.placeholder: Describe your preferred interaction methods and reasoning.

questions.question: Has this assignment changed your view on how AI assistants work and why?
questions.placeholder: Reflect on any changes in your understanding or perspective.
